fields.subject: Expression Debug View
fields.condition: the visited expression node is a dynamic call-site, a runtime-variables node, or an extension node
fields.response: render a dynamic node as `.Dynamic` followed by a binder description derived from the CallSiteBinder's concrete type (for example `Convert Type`, `GetMember Name`, `Call Name`, or `BinaryOperation Op`) and a parenthesized argument list; render a runtime-variables node as `.RuntimeVariables` followed by a parenthesized list of its variables; and render an extension node as `.Extension<RuntimeType>` followed, only when the node reports that it can reduce, by a braced rendering of its reduced expression
